insights.one_liner: OC&C is a London-headquartered strategy consulting firm with a Rotterdam office, a B Corp and IND-recognised sponsor, currently offering consulting internships.

culture.text: A mid-sized strategy firm: about 900+ people across 15 offices, founded in 1987 and run as a partnership.
Staff often come from Oxford, Cambridge, LSE, Bocconi and UCL, and studied economics, business, maths, finance or history.
It specialises in retail, consumer goods, media, technology, B2B services and private equity.
Its 2 open jobs here are both consulting internships in Rotterdam.

open.text: OC&C Strategy Consultants B.V. is an IND recognised sponsor.
Both current postings are open to people who don't speak Dutch.
It is an international firm spanning 10 countries, with headquarters in London.

growth.text: LinkedIn lists 1,116 employees on its page.

worth_knowing.text: OC&C is a Certified B Corporation.
